params.name: scale
params.label: Scale
params.description: Edge length of the cube in world units; the box extends half this distance from Center on every axis.

params.name: wireframe
params.label: Wireframe
params.description: When on, builds only the twelve edges as thin bars and the eight corners as small cubes instead of a solid box, useful as a reference frame.

params.name: center
params.label: Center
params.description: Position of the box's center in world units.
